description.zh:
个人访问令牌。 
使用阿里云AK+SK或使用STS临时授权方式不需要传该字段
description.en: The personal access token. This parameter is not required if you use an Alibaba Cloud AccessKey pair or a Security Token Service (STS) temporary credential for authentication.

description.zh: 企业标识，也称企业id，字符串形式，可在云效访问链接中获取，如https://devops.aliyun.com/organization/【OrganizationId】
description.en: The unique ID of the organization. You can find this ID in your browser's URL after logging in to the Alibaba Cloud DevOps platform: https\://devops.aliyun.com/organization/{organizationId}.
